cases.prompt: Hi, my grandson just installed you on my computer
cases.expect_behavior: two-sentence hello, then the first screen of tappable questions from chewbacca welcome questions; no feature list, no reading private data
pass skip for that question so the safe default applies, and move to the next screen

cases.prompt: Can you talk to me shorter from now on?
cases.expect_behavior: rerun chewbacca welcome save with tone short and the other saved answers unchanged

cases.prompt: I only want help writing letters
cases.expect_behavior: save goals writing and ask for no macOS permission, since that goal needs none

cases.prompt: Ok what else can you set up for me?
cases.expect_behavior: run chewbacca welcome stack, say the first ready step's say line and offer its tap as one button with Not now; skip absent and done steps silently
only after this explicit yes run chewbacca welcome connect recording --yes, then read back its say line, including that the Settings screen is open if permissions were missing
run chewbacca welcome connect google; if blocked, read the one BLOCKED line and say the Google Cloud page is open, never tell them a command or a file path
